theorems.claim: An exact task isomorphism with closed context domain transports every legal bounded path bijectively and therefore preserves bounded target reachability.
theorems.proof: Map every path actionwise by gamma. Transition equivariance proves endpoint transport by induction; target, cost, grammar and selector preservation prove legality in both directions. Apply the inverse maps for reflection.
theorems.killed_form: Outcome agreement alone implies representation isomorphism.

theorems.claim: Target membership is a function of an observation exactly when it is constant on each observation fiber in the certified domain.
theorems.proof: Necessity follows by equal inputs to the putative decision function. For sufficiency define the decision on each realized observation by the common fiber label.

theorems.claim: Coordinatewise semantic coarsening makes each pairwise difference support a subset of its finer support. Pairwise and global minimum deletion cardinalities cannot increase. For a fixed deletion set, the induced equivalence relation only coarsens, so merged pairs, maximum fiber size and target-alias coverage cannot decrease. The identity of an optimizer, support multiplicities, orbit occupancy and lexicographic ranking need not be preserved.
theorems.proof: If coarsened values differ, their antecedent values differ. Projection after pointwise coarsening factors through the finer projection, so every finer fiber is contained in a coarser fiber.

theorems.claim: With fixed task objects and selector-independent grammar, reachability is an up-set in the inclusion order on admissible primitive sets. Nonreachability is a down-set. Representation divergence need not be monotone and its inclusion-minimal boundary is an antichain.
theorems.proof: Every word over M is also a word over N when M is a subset of N. Minimal elements of any finite up-set form an antichain.

theorems.claim: Closure is necessary for a total endomorphism-based pairing of every context inside the same restricted domain; explicit orbit completion is an alternative. Closure is not necessary for a partial pairing or for coincidental outcome equality. Aggregate equality does not establish a contextwise pairing.
theorems.proof: A total internal pairing by g requires g(C) to be contained in C. Cardinality equality of outcome classes supplies no map and no commuting diagram.

theorems.claim: An invertible task isomorphism is sufficient for universal certificate-preserving search reuse. It is necessary only when reuse authority demands preservation and reflection of the full task structure; accidental equality of one query result does not imply isomorphism.
theorems.proof: The isomorphism transports paths and certificates bijectively. The unrestricted iff fails because a lossy or non-homomorphic map can return the same Boolean value on a selected query.

theorems.claim: Under independent interventions, the typed joint readout is the ordered pair of the pure observation and pure action readouts. No statement follows for an arbitrary scalar post-processing functional.
theorems.proof: By A3 and A4 each component consumes only its declared instrument. Product introduction yields the ordered pair; it does not constrain a later coupling functional.

theorems.claim: A joint-only difference is impossible for equality of the typed product outcome when both pure components are equal. A joint-only scalar statistic remains possible if the statistic couples the coordinates.
theorems.proof: Equality is componentwise for ordered pairs. A nonlinear scalar such as conjunction supplies a minimal counterexample to the unrestricted claim.

theorems.claim: Embeddings that preserve and reflect target, observation equality and legal bounded paths transport both separator polarities. Forward simulations transport positive reachability only. Surjective quotient maps preserve target-fiber conclusions only with label constancy. Negative and no-separator transport require backward completeness or reflection; they do not follow from simulation alone.
theorems.proof: Each polarity follows from the direction in which paths, labels and observation fibers are preserved. The missing reverse direction is witnessed by an added target-reaching path in the codomain.

theorems.claim: Every rejected converse or overstrong transport claim is paired with a constructive example and a minimality claim under the frozen order. Minimality is exhaustive where the executable atlas says EXHAUSTIVE and structural otherwise.
theorems.proof: The atlas records executable predicates, witnesses, lower-bound arguments and certification scope.
